description_en: Creates a data backfill workflow by calling RunCycleDagNodes
description_zh: 调用RunCycleDagNodes创建补数据工作流
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public run-cycle-dag-nodes --project-env PROD --start-biz-date 2020-05-20_00:00:00 --name xm_test --root-node-id 1234 --parallelism false --end-biz-date 2020-05-21_00:00:00 --include-node-ids 74324,74325 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCycleDagNodes

parameters.help_en: The environment of the workspace. PROD indicates the production environment. DEV indicates the development environment
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的环境，PROD表示生产环境，DEV表示开发环境
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The start business date for data backfill. Format: yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 补数据的起始业务日期。格式为yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00
parameters.name: start_biz_date

parameters.help_en: The ID of the start node for data backfill. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html operation to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 补数据的起始节点ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html接口获取节点ID
parameters.name: root_node_id

parameters.help_en: The list of node IDs that do not require data backfill. Nodes in this list generate dry-run instances. After a dry-run instance is scheduled, it directly succeeds without executing the script content
parameters.help_zh: 无需补数据的节点ID列表，在这个列表中的节点会生成空跑实例，空跑实例被调度后会直接运行成功，不会执行脚本内容
parameters.name: exclude_node_ids

parameters.help_en: The start time of the node. This parameter is required only for hourly scheduled nodes. Format: HH:mm:ss. Valid values: 00:00:00 to 23:59:59
parameters.help_zh: 任务的开始时间。仅小时调度任务需要设置该参数，格式为HH:mm:ss，取值范围为 00:00:00~23:59:59
parameters.name: biz_begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the node. This parameter is required only for hourly scheduled nodes. Format: HH:mm:ss. Valid values: 00:00:00 to 23:59:59
parameters.help_zh: 任务的结束时间。仅小时调度任务需要设置该参数，格式为HH:mm:ss，取值范围为 00:00:00~23:59:59
parameters.name: biz_end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether nodes across multiple business dates can run in parallel
parameters.help_zh: 多个业务日期的任务是否可以并行运行
parameters.name: parallelism

parameters.help_en: The end business date for data backfill. Format: yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 补数据的结束业务日期。格式为yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00
parameters.name: end_biz_date

parameters.help_en: A JSON string in which the key is the node ID and the value is the actual parameter value
parameters.help_zh: 配置为一个JSON字符串，Key为节点ID，Value为参数的实际取值
parameters.name: node_params

parameters.help_en: The node IDs for data backfill. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html operation to obtain node IDs
parameters.help_zh: 补数据的节点ID。对多个节点补数据时，多个节点ID使用逗号（,）分隔。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html接口获取节点ID
parameters.name: include_node_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to immediately run instances whose scheduling time is in the future. If this parameter is set to true, instances with a scheduling time later than the current time run immediately. Otherwise, the instances wait until the scheduling time
parameters.help_zh: 是否立刻运行未来调度时间的实例，如果设置为true，则大于当前时间的实例会立刻运行，否则会等待调度时间
parameters.name: start_future_instance_immediately

parameters.help_en: The number of concurrent nodes. Valid values: 2 to 10
parameters.name: concurrent_runs

parameters.help_en:
The Alarm Metric. Valid values:
SUCCESS: Alerting on success.
FAILURE: Alerting on failed.
SUCCESS_FAILURE: Alerting on success or failed
parameters.help_zh:
告警类型。取值范围：
SUCCESS：成功告警。
FAILURE：失败告警。
SUCCESS_FAILURE：成功或失败皆告警
parameters.name: alert_type

parameters.help_en:
The alert notification method. Valid values:
SMS: text message.
MAIL: email.
SMS_MAIL: text message and email
parameters.help_zh:
告警通知方式。取值范围：
SMS：短信。
MAIL：邮件。
SMS_MAIL：短信与邮件
parameters.name: alert_notice_type

Data.description_en: The DagId returned by the data backfill instance. You can use this DagId to query the corresponding instances
Data.description_zh: 周期任务补数据返回的DagId，可以通过该DagId查到对应的实例

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
